C3.text: 從 data/services.json 僅選 status=active 且 channel=standard 的服務，產生 reports/shared-tags.json；頂層精確為 schema_version=1 與 shared_tags；列出對應至少兩個不同服務 ID 的全部標籤，按 tag 排序；每列精確含 tag、service_ids，service_ids 去重且排序。
C3.note: 本地驗收通過：獨立逐標籤重算確認完整性、active/standard 篩選、精確欄位、去重與排序。唯一共享標籤 maintenance 對應 S101、S104；驗收記錄 reports/shared-tags-validation.json。僅證明本地新增成果。

limits: Checks state/artifact invariants, not semantic validity of every claim. Review new condition meaning, user handoff, real commands and absence of attempted external actions separately.
